hooks.command: printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"BEHAVIORAL RULES (injected every turn): 1) NEVER GUESS — when stuck, STOP and research: WebSearch, WebFetch, read docs/source. Do NOT chain speculative fixes. 2) Use Agent tool (subagent_type=Explore) for deep codebase research. Use background agents for long investigations. 3) NO SHORTCUTS — find root cause. Quick fixes that paper over issues are worse than no fix. If about to say \"this should work\" without verifying — STOP. 4) Re-read CLAUDE.md rules if uncertain."}}'

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qiE '(rm\s+-rf\s+[/~]|git\s+push\s+.*--force|git\s+push\s+-f|drop\s+table|drop\s+database|truncate\s+table|git\s+reset\s+--hard|git\s+clean\s+-fd|> /dev/sd|mkfs\.|dd\s+if=)' && echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Destructive command blocked by safety hook. Run it manually if intentional."}' && exit 0 || exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -qiE '^git\s+commit' && { msg=$(git log --format=%B -n1 HEAD 2>/dev/null); echo "$msg" | grep -qi 'Co-Authored-By' && { echo "$msg" | sed '/^Co-Authored-By:/d' | sed '/^$/N;/^\n$/d' | git commit --amend -F - >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"VIOLATION: Co-Authored-By was auto-stripped from your commit. NEVER add AI attribution."}}'; } || true; } || true
